Source: opus 0.4.0, crates.io release, https://github.com/SpaceManiac/opus-rs
License: MIT OR Apache-2.0; both original notices retained.
Original lib.rs retained except declaring/re-exporting the dred module.
Thiscord adds src/dred.rs: encoder DRED duration CTL, decoder complexity CTL,
full decoder reinitialization preserving complexity (same allocation, no allocation),
and bounded, owned DRED parse/decode bindings. No borrowed C pointers escape.
Cargo.toml pins opusic-sys =0.7.5 and enables its bundled dred feature.
This dependency is excluded from the application workspace (still 3 packages).
The libopus C sources and built-in model arrays remain in the Cargo.lock-pinned
opusic-sys crate; no build-time model download or native source modification.
